description: Fetch the full attributes of one or more features of a geo.admin.ch layer by feature id (ids come from query_layer_at_point or find_layer_features). Example: layer_id='ch.bfs.gebaeude_wohnungs_register', feature_id='1231641_0'. Up to 10 comma-separated ids.

feature_id.description: Feature id, or up to 10 comma-separated ids

lang.description: Language for labels/attributes: de, fr, it, rm or en (default en)

layer_id.description: geo.admin.ch layer id (BOD id), e.g. 'ch.bafu.laerm-strassenlaerm_tag', find ids with search_map_layers

name: get_layer_feature
title: Get geo.admin.ch feature(s) by id
